notes.text: NVIDIA Video Codec SDK for Linux contains a vulnerability where a user may cause a heap-based buffer overflow issue. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to code execution, data tampering, and denial of service.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: code execution, data tampering, denial of service, information disclosure
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA Jetson Linux for Linux contains a vulnerability where an attacker may cause an out of bounds write. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to escalation of privileges and denial of service.
notes.title: Vulnerability description

notes.text: escalation of privileges, denial of service
notes.title: Impacts

notes.text: NVIDIA Open GPU Kernel Module for Linux contains a vulnerability where a user may cause a use-after-free issue. A successful exploit of this vulnerability may lead to code execution, escalation of privileges, data tampering, denial of service, and information disclosure.
